svg.title: Three different boundaries in the same correlation family
svg.desc: For the family P sub v defined in the article, v ranges from zero to one and CHSH S equals four v. Bell-local models exist up to v equal to one half. Quantum models exist up to v equal to one over square root of two, approximately 0.7071. No-signalling holds through v equal to one. All sixteen global assignments are compatible with the supports for every v below one; at one none is compatible. In particular v equal to three fifths is quantum and Bell-nonlocal despite having all sixteen support assignments.

g.text: One probability family · S = 4v · constructed data
At v = 3/5: S = 12/5, above the local bound.
Their weights cannot reproduce the table.
At v = 1, the support itself has no global assignment.
